referenceOnly.use: Provenance and preservation constraints; statements in this document were not treated as current verification.
Reference package only; not unpacked, rebuilt, or substituted for the Guided Edition.

verification.sourceComparison: pass: preserved instructional and assessment content matches the imported source after accounting for pilot guides, learner-facing navigation/resource revisions, the teacher-requested Video Lessons cleanup, and the new textbook viewer labels
verification.dataContracts: pass: vocabulary, textbook questions, checks, labels, and milestones are byte-identical to the preserved raw source; all 32 original route IDs remain present exactly once after the requested sidebar regrouping
verification.guideCoverage: pass: all 31 intended routes have exactly one guide and every guide begins collapsed
verification.keyboardDisclosure: pass: Enter opens a focused lesson guide
verification.localSaveReload: pass: a Chapter 9 required-check response restored after page reload
verification.mobileWidth390: pass: Practice Lab guide and embedded activity rendered without horizontal page overflow
verification.biologyShellParity: pass: the desktop shell now uses the Biology Pilot 3 title hierarchy, top progress block, bottom sidebar action, bordered lesson frame, goal strip, and 78px collapsed rail
verification.responsiveFrame: pass: at 1667px the lesson frame expands from 1120px to 1380px when the sidebar closes; the goal strip expands with it and neither state overflows horizontally
verification.mobileShell: pass: at 390px the goal strip becomes one column, the page has no horizontal overflow, and the navigation drawer opens to 310px
verification.vocabularyReader: pass: all 74 preserved Chemistry terms appear in the Biology-style category index and selecting a term updates the reader
verification.lessonTermLinks: pass: existing lesson text is enhanced at runtime with accessible term buttons; the representative Chapter 9 lesson exposed 29 links and opened the matching side drawer
verification.vocabularySaveContinuity: pass: a Frayer response entered in the lesson drawer appeared in Core Vocabulary and survived reload through the existing data-save field
verification.referencePanel: pass: the persistent Reference sheet control opens a non-modal panel that remained open during lesson navigation, moved by its heading, and exposed CSS corner resizing
verification.mobileVocabulary: pass: at 390px the Core Vocabulary layout becomes one column, the term drawer fills the viewport width, and neither state overflows horizontally
verification.browserConsole: pass: no page or console errors in the focused browser check
verification.sidebarNavigation: pass: the sidebar now uses Biology Pilot 3 typography and its Start, Learn, Practice & Review, Tools, Process Collection, and Resources hierarchy; all top-level sections and the three nested chapter groups are collapsible, and the active route opens its owning groups automatically
verification.videoLibraryLearnerCopy: pass: the selected Internet and access and original-video-collections blocks are absent, export/source wording was removed from the three playlist cards, and existing video load controls remain
verification.textbookPageMapping: pass: all 21 lesson textbook bands expose their referenced range starts; separated ranges receive separate controls, producing 27 lesson/review page entry points
verification.textbookModal: pass: lesson and Textbook Practice controls open the embedded chapter PDF at the mapped PDF page in a modal, restore focus on close, and create no new browser tab
verification.textbookLibrary: pass: Resources now contains Textbook Library with three chapter selectors, printed-page input, and an embedded chapter reader
verification.mobileTextbook: pass: at 390px the library has zero horizontal overflow and the textbook modal fills the 390 by 844 viewport
verification.processCollectionCurrentPreview: observed: 4 visible records are supplied reaction-profile starting values; 0 completed practice attempts and 0 of 24 finished lessons were present in the reviewed browser record
verification.frayerCollection: pass: four preserved Frayer fields save through one explicit control and render as one Vocabulary Frayers entry; incomplete Frayers remain labelled as drafts
verification.organizedProcessCollection: pass: All My Work is grouped by Vocabulary Frayers, Written responses, Equation and textbook work, Energy diagrams, Models and simulations, Checked practice, and Interactive activities; related investigation and textbook fields rendered as one entry each in the isolated focused check
